hero.promise: I build apps, websites and software that take your business off paper, automate the routine work and show you clear numbers.

problems.intro: Most growing businesses I meet have the same six problems.

items.quote: We type the same data again and again.
items.detail: Dispatch slips become invoices, POs go into your system, bills go into your books. All by hand.

items.quote: We don't know our real numbers until it's too late.
items.detail: Sales, stock and dues sit in different sheets and different heads, so you find out what happened long after it could have helped.

items.quote: Everything happens on WhatsApp, and nothing is recorded.
items.detail: Orders, production and dispatch get agreed in chats and are forgotten by evening.
Chasing money is awkward and easy to forget, so it stays with your customers longer than it should.

items.quote: Our dealer or distributor network is hard to manage.
items.detail: Price lists, orders and ledgers live in different places, and every dealer question turns into a phone call.

items.quote: Every tool we try makes us change how we work.
items.detail: Off-the-shelf software forces its own process on your business, and your team stops using it.

pillars.title: Digitise
pillars.summary: Registers, paper slips and WhatsApp orders move into one system your team can use from any phone.

pillars.title: Automate
pillars.summary: Invoices, follow-ups and payment reminders go out on their own. You approve, and the system does the rest.

pillars.title: Analyse
pillars.summary: Sales, stock, dues and customers in one weekly report, with the few things that need your attention flagged.

page.metaTitle: Business automation and MIS reporting for Indian businesses
page.metaDescription: Invoice automation, payment reminders, WhatsApp data entry, document capture and automated MIS reports for growing businesses in India. Works with your Excel sheets and billing software exports.
page.intro: Most growing businesses lose hours every week retyping data, chasing payments and building reports by hand. I set up automations that do that routine work for you: invoices drafted from dispatch slips, reminders sent on time, bills read into clean data, and a weekly report on your phone that shows sales, stock and dues. Everything works with the data and tools you already use, and invoices go to customers only after your approval.
forWho: Manufacturers, distributors, warehouses and retailers who still retype dispatch slips, POs and bills
Businesses that run orders and daily updates on WhatsApp
Owners who only see their real numbers at month end
Teams that spend too much time chasing payments

faq.q: Does this work with Tally or our billing software?
faq.a: Usually, yes. I work with the exports your billing and accounting software already produces, such as Excel or CSV files, so you keep using what you have.

faq.q: Will WhatsApp messages come from our own number?
faq.a: Yes. I set up a dedicated WhatsApp Business number in your company's name, and reminders and updates go out from it. WhatsApp's message fees are billed at cost.

faq.q: What is Business Pulse?
faq.a: An automated MIS: a weekly report on your phone and email, plus a simple dashboard of sales, stock, dispatch and dues, with the few things that need your attention flagged and the customers who have gone quiet. If you'd rather start small, share three months of data for a one-off, one-page report with three decisions to act on.

faq.q: Do you use AI, and is our data safe?
faq.a: AI is used where it helps, such as reading bills and invoices, and its usage is billed at cost as a separate line. Access is limited by role and your data is backed up weekly.

page.metaTitle: Android and iPhone app development in Raipur, India
page.metaDescription: Android and iPhone apps for procurement, B2B ordering, payments and team collaboration, built once for both. Every app includes an admin dashboard, secure login and publishing to the Play Store and App Store.
page.intro: An app puts your business in the pocket of your team, your suppliers and your buyers. I build procurement apps for supplier search, requisitions and approvals; B2B ordering apps where buyers browse your catalog, reorder and manage their account; collaboration apps that keep projects and team updates in one place; and payment apps for invoicing, vendor payments and collections. Each app is built once for both Android and iPhone, and comes with an admin dashboard so you stay in control.
forWho: Businesses whose purchase requests and approvals run on calls, chats and paper
Manufacturers and distributors whose B2B buyers order again and again
Teams spread across sites who need projects and updates in one place
Businesses that send invoices, pay vendors and chase payments every week
Founders who need a first version (MVP) that can grow

faq.q: Do you build for both Android and iPhone?
faq.a: Yes. Each app is built once in Flutter, Google's toolkit for making one app that runs on both, and released on both, so you don't pay for two separate apps.

faq.q: Do I need both Android and iPhone?
faq.a: Not always. An app for your own staff can go Android only if everyone on the team uses Android phones, which also saves the yearly Apple fee. Because the app is built once for both, adding iPhone later means testing and publishing it, not rebuilding it.

faq.q: Who owns and pays for the app store accounts?
faq.a: Your business. The Play Store and App Store accounts are created in your name, and you pay their fees directly to Google and Apple: a one-time fee of about ₹2,400 for Google Play and about ₹9,000 a year for Apple. I guide you through setting them up, then manage them for you, or you add me as a developer.

faq.q: How long do the app stores take to approve the app?
faq.a: Typically 7–14 days after I submit it, and sometimes longer. Apple and Google review every new app and every update, and sometimes ask for changes before approving; I handle the submission and anything the reviewers ask for. The store review is built into the timeline in your proposal.

faq.q: How do updates reach the people using the app?
faq.a: Through the Play Store and App Store, like any other app update. Bug fixes are covered by the monthly plan, and after the first {{adjustmentDays}} days small changes up to {{smallChangeHours}} hours a month are included; new screens or features are quoted first.

faq.q: Can the app connect to software we already use?
faq.a: Yes. The app can work with systems you already have, such as Tally, your website or a payment gateway. Each connection is named and priced in the scope before work starts.

faq.q: Does the app work on weak internet?
faq.a: Apps used on site or on the road can be built to keep working on weak or no internet and sync once the connection is back. This is agreed in the scope.

faq.q: How many users can the app handle?
faq.a: I build for business teams, dealers and customers, typically up to 50,000 to 90,000 monthly active users. For a mass-market consumer app, a larger team will serve you better.

page.metaDescription: Custom ERP, CRM, dealer and distributor platforms and internal tools, built around how your business already runs. No per-user fees, and you can buy the software outright.
page.intro: Off-the-shelf software makes you change how you work, and charges you for every user. I build ERPs, CRMs, dealer and distributor platforms and internal tools around the way your business already runs, so your team actually uses them. Larger systems start with one workflow and grow from there, and you can buy the software outright whenever you want.
forWho: Businesses that have outgrown Excel sheets and WhatsApp groups
Manufacturers tracking production, stock and dispatch across sheets and registers
Distributors and brands managing dealers, agents or price tiers
Teams paying per-user fees for software that doesn't fit
Companies that need a tool for a job no product does well

faq.q: Why custom software instead of an off-the-shelf product?
faq.a: When a product fits your process, I'll tell you to use it. Custom software makes sense when a product forces its own process on you, charges per user, or can't handle your pricing, approvals or reports.

faq.q: Can you move our existing data in?
faq.a: Yes. Setup includes moving your existing records in from up to {{dataFiles}} source files, such as Excel sheets or software exports. More are quoted.

faq.q: Can it connect to Tally or a payment gateway?
faq.a: Yes. Integrations such as Tally or payments are scoped and priced in your proposal.

faq.q: Can we start small?
faq.a: Yes. For larger systems we start with one workflow, then expand once your team is using it.

faq.q: How is this different from Zoho, Tally or a ready-made ERP?
faq.a: Tally stays your accounting system, and the software I build works alongside it. Ready-made ERPs and CRMs like Zoho suit businesses whose process matches theirs, and charge for every user. A custom system follows your own pricing, approvals and reports, with no per-user fees.

faq.q: Are we locked in to you?
faq.a: No. Your data is yours, with a full export if the plan ends. You can buy the source code outright at any time, and if I ever stop offering the service, the code and your data pass to you free of charge.

options.text: Ask about orders, stock, dealers or customers in plain language and get an answer from your own records.

addon.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes, including wrong or made-up answers, so I build it to suggest and draft, and your team checks before acting on it. I'm not responsible for its output or for decisions based on it.

process.step: Fill out the form, then a free call or Google Meet
process.label: Form and free call
process.blurb: I reply within 48 hours by email or WhatsApp, and on a free call we go through how you work today.
process.detail: Tell me which services you need. I reply by email or WhatsApp within 48 hours, and we set up a call where you walk me through how things work today, your budget and when you'd like to start. I'll tell you whether you need custom software at all, or whether a free product already does the same job.

process.step: Discovery, then a written proposal in 5–7 days
process.label: Discovery and proposal
process.blurb: I visit if you're in Raipur, or you walk me through on a screen share, and within 5–7 days you get a free, no-obligation proposal with scope, price and timeline.
process.detail: I see how your business runs, with a visit if you're in or around Raipur or a screen share if you're further away, and you work with me personally from here to launch. Within 5–7 days you get a written proposal, free and with no obligation: how I understand your business, what the system will do, and the scope, price, timeline and payment schedule. It stays valid for {{validDays}} days, and the detailed design comes after you approve it. For a deeper analysis before deciding, the paid workflow audit gives you a written report you keep.

process.step: Prototype, then a build in stages
process.label: Prototype and build
process.blurb: Once you approve the proposal and pay 50% of setup, I build a prototype for your sign-off, then demo each milestone. Changes within the agreed scope are included.
process.detail: Once you approve the proposal and pay 50% of the setup fee, I work out the detailed design and build a prototype as the first milestone. Your team signs it off before the full build. For larger systems we start with one workflow and expand. You see a demo at each milestone, and changes within the agreed scope are included; new features are quoted separately. The other 50% is due when it goes to live testing.

process.step: Launch, then training for your team
process.label: Launch and training
process.blurb: I set it up and run a handover session, so your team can use it confidently from day one.
process.detail: I set it up and run a handover session so your team knows how to use it. If you need more, such as extra sessions or on-site training, it's quoted in your proposal.

process.label: Hosting and support
process.blurb: I keep it hosted, backed up and secure on a monthly plan, or on a maintenance plan if you bought it outright, and we review how it's used at 60–90 days.
process.detail: The monthly plan keeps it hosted, up and secure, with bug fixes. We review how it's being used at 60–90 days. After the first 90 days, small changes up to 3 hours a month are included; bigger changes are quoted. If you bought the code outright, you get 30 days of free bug fixes, then an optional maintenance plan.

nda: I'll sign an NDA before we talk if you want one.

faq.q: Our team isn't very tech-savvy. Will this work for us?
faq.a: Most likely. I keep the screens simple so teams pick them up quickly, and they work on a phone. A handover session is included in setup; extra or on-site training is quoted in your proposal. You'll need one person on your side who owns it day to day.

faq.q: Do we have to replace our current software?
faq.a: No. I usually work with the data your software already exports, like Excel or CSV files, so you keep what you use today.

faq.q: How does the monthly plan work?
faq.a: You pay a setup fee to get the software built, then a monthly fee to use it. Think of it as a licence: you use the software for as long as the plan runs, and you can buy it outright whenever you like. The plan covers hosting, backups, uptime monitoring, bug fixes and security updates. For the first {{adjustmentDays}} days after go-live, adjustments to what I built are included. After that, up to {{smallChangeHours}} hours of small changes a month are included. Bigger changes are quoted before I start.

faq.q: Does the monthly fee go up for a bigger project?
faq.a: A bigger system has more to host and support, so the monthly plan rises with the size of the project, but more slowly than the setup fee. As a rule of thumb, if the setup fee doubles, the monthly plan goes up by about {{growthPercent}}%. The exact figures are agreed in your quote.

faq.q: What counts as a change?
faq.a: If something doesn't work the way we agreed, it's a bug and I fix it free. If it works as agreed and you'd like it to work differently, or you want something new, that's a change.

faq.q: How quickly do you fix problems?
faq.a: On working days (Monday to Friday), I reply to anything that stops your work within {{replyUrgentDays}} business day, and to everything else within {{replyOtherDays}} business days.

faq.q: Can we buy the software outright?
faq.a: Yes, at any time. You receive the full source code as it stands on the day you buy, and the monthly plan ends. The price is agreed before you commit, and what you've already paid counts toward it: the setup fee, plus {{creditPercent}}% of your monthly fees. The price never drops below {{floorPercent}}% of the agreed outright price. The terms page has a worked example. After buying, you get 30 days of free bug fixes; then you can run hosting yourself or keep me on a maintenance plan that covers bug fixes, security updates and up to {{smallChangeHours}} hours of small changes a month.

faq.q: Who owns our data?
faq.a: You do, always. If the plan ends, you get a full export of your data. See also "Can we buy the software outright?"

faq.q: Whose name are the accounts in?
faq.a: Yours. App store accounts, your domain, your WhatsApp number and payment gateway are all created in your business's name. For the domain, you can buy it yourself and give me access, or I can buy it for you; either way it sits in your own account. I manage the rest for you, or you add me as a developer.

faq.q: Are there other costs?
faq.a: GST at {{gst}}% is added to all prices. AI usage and third-party services such as WhatsApp are billed at cost, as separate lines on your monthly bill. Every service your system uses is listed in the agreement before work starts, so nothing new appears later without your approval.

faq.q: What if we want to stop?
faq.a: Monthly plans start with a {{minMonths}}-month minimum. If you need to leave inside those {{minMonths}} months, you can choose: pay two months' plan fees and end the plan, or buy the software outright. After {{minMonths}} months you can leave with {{noticeDays}} days' notice. Either way you get an export of your data, and the accounts stay in your name.

faq.q: What if you stop working on this?
faq.a: If I ever stop offering the service, the code and your data pass to you free of charge, so your business is never stuck.

faq.q: How do payments work?
faq.a: Setup is paid in two parts: {{setupPayment}}. Live testing is when real users first start using it, before it goes fully live. The monthly plan starts at go-live, after live testing, and is invoiced each month. UPI is accepted.

faq.q: Is our data safe?
faq.a: Access is limited by role, your data is backed up weekly as standard, and I'll sign an NDA if you want one. Daily backups are available as a paid add-on.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: Websites take 1–5 weeks, automation and analysis 4–16 weeks, mobile apps 4–12 weeks and custom software 5–20 weeks. The clock starts once you've sent your data and approvals. Your proposal will say exactly.

faq.q: Which AI do you use, and who pays for it?
faq.a: I use the latest models from leading AI providers, picked for each task. AI usage and third-party fees such as WhatsApp aren't included in your monthly fee. They're billed at cost as separate lines on your monthly bill, and each one is named in the scope before we start.

faq.q: Do you visit us in person?
faq.a: If you're in or around Raipur, yes. I visit your office, shop or warehouse to see how work gets done and which software, sheets and apps you use. If you're further away, you walk me through it on a screen share. Either way you work with me personally, from the first look to launch, with no salesperson or middleman in between.

faq.q: Can I see a demo built for my business before committing?
faq.a: Yes. I can build a working demo around your own process and data, so you see exactly how it would work for you. It's priced as a small share of the estimated project fee, confirmed once we've discussed the scope of work (SOW).

faq.q: Can you build an app for millions of users?
faq.a: That's not what I focus on. I build systems for businesses and their teams, dealers and customers, from a handful of users up to typically 50,000 to 90,000 monthly active users. I can also build MVPs designed to grow to that size. I'm a one-person studio, and that focus keeps your costs predictable and lets me give each client proper attention. If you're building a mass-market consumer app, a larger team will serve you better, and I'm happy to point you to one.

cta.title: Need a proper estimate?

requirement.title: Before you send the form
requirement.body: Automation only works when your team uses it. Most Indian businesses already work on WhatsApp, so that is the usual choice: I set up a dedicated WhatsApp Business number for your company. Telegram or a simple portal work too, and we can choose according to your use case. Someone on your side runs it day to day.

cta.summary: Tell me which services you need and what's slowing your business down. Fill out the form, and you'll get a reply by email or WhatsApp within 48 hours.
cta.note: Need a website as well? Websites with lead capture are available alongside any of the services above.

pricingIntro.title: Software built around your business, run for you every month.
pricingIntro.body: You pay a setup fee and a monthly plan. I host it, fix it and keep it up to date, so your team just uses it. If you'd rather own it, you can buy it outright at any time.
